criteria.description: The authenticated session list reads durable repository state and observes create, refresh and revocation performed by another API instance with deterministic newest-first ordering.
criteria.limitations: The proof uses disposable local PostgreSQL and two local API service instances; it does not certify target topology or remote CI.

criteria.description: The public route preserves the existing permission check, session_list audit action, response envelope and public session semantics.
criteria.limitations: This is bounded route evidence and does not certify every authentication endpoint.

criteria.description: The service enforces account/user isolation, deterministic tie ordering, exact public projection, in-memory compatibility and fail-closed repository errors without stale-cache fallback.
criteria.limitations: The contract covers the session-list boundary only; broader token, MFA and distributed-state semantics remain outside scope.

criteria.description: Focused auth/route/server/PostgreSQL/process regression evidence is green or explicitly environment-skipped, and the compiled API regression remains green.
criteria.limitations: The Docker-backed process test was skipped on this host because Docker was unavailable.

criteria.description: Official coverage, typecheck/build, secret, OpenAPI, migration-source, RLS, formatting and diff-hygiene checks meet the bounded quality bar.
criteria.limitations: Workspace-local quality evidence does not replace target, provider, production or release acceptance; unrelated global lint failures remain documented.

criteria.description: Independent bounded review approves the final slice and fresh parity evidence explicitly prevents global ERP promotion.
criteria.limitations: The approval is limited to this repository-local session-list boundary; global ERP, production, target, provider, deployment and release readiness remain unapproved.

next_action: Reconcile the control plane, then return to fresh residual scouting under a new authority. Keep parent CVG-001/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
